From the Grub-Street Journal. VIII. Epigram (“Great G[eorge]”)

The sting of this epigram was for Cibber, then Poet Laureate.
G
REAT
 G[eorge] such servants since thou well canst lack,
Oh! save the salary, and drink the sack.
